blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Mandaue City Council passed a resolution formally requesting the Visayan Electric Company (VECO) to implement a staggered payment scheme for electricity bills from the August and September billing cycles, extending until December 2026 without penalties or disconnections. The measure was authored by Councilor Jennifer Del Mar. It cites the council’s duty to protect the welfare and economic stability of its constituents during periods of severe financial difficulty, noting that an unprecedented surge in power rates has heavily burdened households, micro-retailers, and local businesses, disrupting household budgets and risking widespread disconnections.
